findings.summary: Live legacy catalog uses KDI_SEMANTIC_V2 names/order that differ from the locked semantic_index_v1 contract.
findings.action: Keep legacy rows immutable; new indexing must use semantic_index_v1 and a separately versioned mapping/migration before rollout.

findings.summary: Historical embedding bundle includes OpenCLIP visual and Ollama text lineage; this is not a semantic-layer substitute.
findings.action: Preserve historical vectors and explicitly configure the accepted text/visual models for new indexing before rollout.

findings.action: Do not rewrite history; require canonical validator fields for new V1 runs.
